Source: Spotify extended streaming history, Streaming_History_Audio and _Video files, 2018–2026. IP addresses and device identifiers were left out of this page.

Times are converted from UTC to Sri Lanka time (UTC+5:30). Hours count actual milliseconds played, so partial plays count partially.

Skip = ended with the next button or flagged as skipped. Streak = consecutive days with at least one play.
